# Lakeside Spine & Wellness

> Chiropractic and wellness clinic in Round Rock, Texas (greater Austin) offering drug-free, non-surgical relief for back pain, neck pain, sciatica, herniated discs, migraines, posture problems and auto injuries. Same-week appointments, on-site digital X-ray, 15+ years of experience, gentle techniques, transparent pricing.

- Location: 1200 Lakeside Pkwy, Suite 110, Round Rock, TX 78665
- Phone: (555) 0142
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM-6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM-1:00 PM
- Areas served: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Hutto, Cedar Park, North Austin
- Lead provider: Dr. Elena Marsh, DC (15+ years)

## Offer
- $49 New Patient Special: consultation + exam + first adjustment (digital X-rays included when clinically needed). Book online: https://referrernation-web.github.io/lakeside-spine/#book
- Free 10-minute phone consult: (555) 0142

## Services
- Chiropractic adjustments (gentle, low-force options)
- Non-surgical spinal decompression for herniated or bulging discs and sciatica
- Corrective care and posture correction
- Migraine and headache relief
- Auto-injury and whiplash care with documentation
- On-site digital X-ray

## Pricing (self-pay)
- New Patient Special: $49
- Follow-up adjustment: $65
- Spinal decompression session: $95
- Corrective care plan: from $55/visit
- Accepts most major insurance, HSA and FSA
